import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import gen as G

def timeit(req):
    line = json.dumps(req) + '\n'
    t0 = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=line, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=200)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    return dt, r.returncode, r.stdout.strip()[:80]

rng = random.Random(7)

        for cap in [1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16]:

            if dt > 0.8:
                worst.append((dt, nn, pathlen, cap))
